profile.professionalTitle: Business Informatics Student | Web Developer | Project Manager
profile.headline: Building digital solutions with purpose.
profile.biography:
I'm Marcus, a fourth-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student majoring in Business Informatics (BAM) at PHINMA Araullo University.

I'm interested in building useful digital experiences and technology-driven business solutions. My academic work has included smart scheduling, e-commerce, and payroll systems — projects where I both developed and coordinated the work.

I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, and Node.js, and I enjoy solving practical problems through software.

Most of my experience comes from academic projects where I have balanced hands-on development with project coordination, organizing timelines, delegating responsibilities, and supporting team communication.

I'm looking for opportunities to grow as a developer and contribute to teams that build useful, well-designed products.

projects.title: Shoe Ordering System

projects.title: Our Little Space
projects.summary: A private, invite-only web app for two people — chat, diary, photo memories, collections and a timeline, with privacy enforced on the server.
projects.description: A private two-person world: real-time chat, a shared diary, a photo memory library, collections and a combined timeline — built as a full-stack TypeScript app with server-side privacy enforcement.
projects.overview: A private, invite-only space for exactly two people with real-time messaging, a shared diary, photo memories, collections and a timeline — on a persistent SQLite-compatible database where every privacy rule is enforced in the SQL, not by hiding buttons.
projects.problem: Couples have no single private place for their shared life: chat apps are ephemeral, cloud photo libraries mix personal and shared freely, and diary apps are single-user. This project solves it with a hard-capped two-member space where visibility is decided in every query and media is served only to authenticated members.
objectives: Build a complete private space for exactly two people with no privacy leak paths
Enforce all access control server-side on every request, including media
Ship real-time messaging (edits, deletes, reactions, read receipts, typing, presence) over authenticated WebSockets
Use a persistent, relational data layer (SQLite/libsql) with migrations
Keep the app operable by two non-technical users: seeding, demo data and one-command dev/deploy
keyFeatures: Home dashboard with recent messages, photos, diary entries, favourites and quick actions
Private real-time chat with reactions, replies, edits, deletes, read receipts, typing indicators and presence
Shared diary with per-entry visibility (Only me / Both of us) enforced in SQL, never in the client
Photo memories with a responsive grid, fullscreen viewer, captions, tags and favourites
Collections with covers and safe deletion that never deletes contents
Combined timeline grouping each day's photos, diary entries and messages
Full-text search across messages, diary, photos, collections and tags
Security: scrypt password hashing, HMAC session cookies, closed two-member registration, content-sniffed WebP uploads and rate limiting
contributions: Designed and built the full stack end to end: Express + Socket.IO API, React + Vite frontend and the relational schema
Implemented the privacy architecture: session-chain authorization and visibility rules in the SQL WHERE clause
Built the image pipeline: content sniffing, EXIF rotation, WebP re-encoding and thumbnails via sharp
Developed real-time messaging over authenticated Socket.IO with per-user/per-space rooms
Created the design system, mobile navigation and Framer Motion transitions across 11 pages
Wrote the seed, demo-seed and 75-check verification scripts, plus Docker/Fly.io deployment setup
Migrated the data layer to libsql with remote (Turso-compatible) support
